item.title: An AI-Powered Rubber Duck Is The Way Forward
item.description: Error: EACCES: permission denied, open '/var/log/application.log' You stare at the error on your screen, and frustration builds as the red text blinks at you. You search through docs, Google, forums, and Stack Overflow. Sometimes, you even ask on IRC. Others had similar problems, but their situations were different from yours, their solution didn’t work. Sometimes, you think Google has the answer, but you end up on page 3 or even page 10, still searching.
